references.text: Moses encourages Israel not to fear as they enter the land, delivering the same message of courage and trust in God
Israel must not fear their enemies because the Lord is with them, a mighty and awesome God
Exhortation to be strong and courageous, do not fear the enemy, for the Lord goes with you
Joshua receives the same command to be strong and courageous, not to fear or lose heart
Joshua encourages his men not to fear or lose heart in battle against their enemies
God's promise not to fear because He is with His people and will strengthen them
Similar exhortation to Judah not to fear the great army, for the battle belongs to God
Joshua and Caleb urge the people not to fear the people in the land, for the Lord is with them
